RollingGo 酒店预订助手 1.0.3 (重大升级版)

- Skill 改名为 rollinggo-hotel-booking，命令行接口切换为 rgh，新增对 Node/Python/独立二进制三类安装方式的支持
- 新增详细的工作流程和安全门控，包括登录授权、动态命令自探知、下单前确认、锁价时效管理
- 大幅增强自然语言触发词覆盖与用例说明，支持更多筛选和预订场景
- 明确强制输出模板，拒绝技术细节直出，仅展示关键信息（如酒店名、价格、标签、图片），全程格式化卡片输出
- 支持每日自动版本检查及更新提醒；详细降级重试及人性化搜索提示
- 技术实现部分新增 scripts/install.py、scripts/rgh.js/py 等辅助脚本，移除旧 references 和 skill-card 文档

- Added new reference file: references/claw-host-env.md
- Updated metadata: included skillKey and revised installation instructions to use rollinggo@latest
- Clarified environment loading and API Key configuration with reference to the new document
- Simplified and reorganized section on environment selection and persistent configuration
- Updated uvx and npm version upgrade instructions for clarity and consistency

- 技能名称由 rollinggo-hotel-cn 更改为 rollinggo-searchhotel
- 环境变量名由 AIGOHOTEL_API_KEY 改为 RollingGo_API_KEY
- 增加“版本新鲜度”说明，默认每次执行时始终使用最新版 CLI，并提供升级命令
- 其余核心功能及用法保持不变

Initial release of rollinggo-hotel-cn.

- Enables hotel search, filtering, and detail checking via the RollingGo CLI.
- Supports queries by destination, date, budget, star rating, tags, and distance.
- Allows retrieval of hotel tags, room type details, and real-time pricing.
- Provides command references and workflow guidance for typical use cases.
- Includes environment setup information and API key application instructions.
- Implements fallback strategies for broader search results if no matches are found.
